opportunities.name: AP three-hit hunter
opportunities.objective: Test ap three-hit hunter against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Dirty Fighting's third hit has a 0.6 AP magic ratio; Nashor and Rageblade support ordinary double-shot attacks while Terminus supports mixed damage. Avengerang's AP movement bonus can help maintain firing range, but Heroic Swing remains physical and collision limited.
opportunities.requiredState: Complete repeated ordinary attack and Q cycles.
opportunities.failure: Losing AD lowers swing and ultimate damage, often losing the first reset.
opportunities.test: Compare passive magic damage and normal attacks separately from swing shots.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Do not assume every swing bullet inherits full item on-hit effects.

opportunities.name: Swing spell bruiser
opportunities.objective: Test swing spell bruiser against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Heroic Swing's repeated physical shots and Avengerang's two passes suggest Cleaver stacking and Shojin ability pressure; Eclipse adds a short shield after separate hits. Earn Muramana through Manamune; use its physical spell packet only after testing swing classification.
opportunities.requiredState: A usable grapple arc and a fully earned Tear transform.
opportunities.failure: Champion collision or a screened Comeuppance cancels the payoff.
opportunities.test: Measure swing damage and armor stacks with identical arcs.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Going Rogue is unresolved; revival value cannot justify damage assumptions.

ruledOut.reason: Do not assume every swing bullet inherits full item on-hit effects.

unknowns: Item and ability proc attribution requires a controlled current-patch test; symbolic statFormula and source flags are not runtime verification.

builds.name: AP three-hit hunter
builds.summary: Test ap three-hit hunter against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test ap three-hit hunter against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Dirty Fighting's third hit has a 0.6 AP magic ratio; Nashor and Rageblade support ordinary double-shot attacks while Terminus supports mixed damage. Avengerang's AP movement bonus can help maintain firing range, but Heroic Swing remains physical and collision limited.
testPlan: Required state: Complete repeated ordinary attack and Q cycles.
Compare passive magic damage and normal attacks separately from swing shots.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Losing AD lowers swing and ultimate damage, often losing the first reset.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Do not assume every swing bullet inherits full item on-hit effects.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Hextech Gunblade, Banshee's Veil, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
After launching an Attack, Akshan will fire an additional shot for [(0.5) × AD] physical damage. He can cancel this shot to instead gain [(characterLevelInterpolation(20 → 75; raw flags preserved)) × ((1 + (1) × Stat(4)[statFormula=2]))] Move Speed decaying over [1] second.

Every three hits from Attacks or Abilities deals an additional [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=15, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 25.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 40.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 70.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. Against champions, Akshan also gains [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 280; raw flags preserved) + (0.35) × AD[statFormula=2]] Shield for [2] seconds ([characterLevelBreakpoints(start=16, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] second Cooldown).

Akshan throws a boomerang that deals [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165 + (0.7) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, extending the range each time an enemy is hit.

Champion hits grant Akshan [0.2 + (0.0005) × AP] Move Speed decaying over [1] second.

First Cast: Akshan fires a grappling hook, attaching to the first terrain hit.

Second Cast: Akshan swings around the terrain, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy for [(8 / 16 / 24 / 32 / 40 + (0.25) × AD) × ((1 + (0.3) × Stat(4)[statFormula=2]))] physical damage per shot.

Third Cast: Akshan dives off the rope, firing a final shot.

Colliding with an enemy Champion or terrain ends the swing early.

Champion takedowns refresh this Ability's Cooldown.
